minutes.headline: Finance Committee backed the FY20 budget adjustment and Saliba land purchase, deferring several special Town Meeting articles
minutes.summary: The committee heard the land acquisition chair present the Saliba conservation and recreation purchase and the land use director present an earth removal bylaw. The committee then voted its recommendations article by article, approving some, deferring several to Town Meeting, and giving no recommendation on the old primary school demolition question.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted to recommend the FY20 budget adjustment article for special Town Meeting.
The committee deferred the streetlight LED conversion, sewer service area map, Code of Lunenburg bylaw, butterfly lane and liquor license articles to Town Meeting.
It recommended the special purpose stabilization fund, the sewer funding source correction and the property gift articles.
On the non-binding old primary school demolition article, the committee gave no recommendation, 5-0 with one abstention.
The vote on the Saliba property purchase is recorded as not audible, so its outcome is not confirmed in the minutes.

why_it_matters: The articles touch the town budget, mostly taxes: a surplus appropriation, a sewer cost moved to a reserve fund, and a land purchase partly offset by state grants. Residents at Town Meeting will be asked to vote on each, including several the committee left without its own recommendation.
watch_next: The October 24 meeting, where all warrant articles are to be revisited on the agenda.
A clear record of the Saliba purchase vote, which the captions did not capture.

reconciliation.summary: Most votes match, but two points differ: our record could not hear the Article G outcome, and the liquor-license articles are recorded as one vote in ours and two in the official minutes. The sewer transfer amount ($9,993 vs $7,513.66) and the next-meeting decision (October 24 vs an October 29 symposium) also conflict. Our record also misses the Article E vote and the Article F deferral.
